scope: Additive TH18 regular Dragon Rider direct-parent baseline and post-July L6 numeric observation.
game_version: The official 2026-07-09 note confirms an unquantified further L6 reduction after May. Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 and publishes the resulting L6 parent HP and DPS.

sources.title: Destruction From High Above!
sources.limitations: The launch note establishes defense priority, single-target attack, ground-and-air target class, housing 25, speed 20, L1 340 DPS/4,100 HP/700 destruction damage, and early L2-L3 death damage. It does not publish range, projectile timing, death radius, current L4-L6 values or deterministic interactions.

sources.title: State of Gameplay - Part 2
sources.limitations: The published May table changes L6 from 6,200 HP/520 DPS to 6,000 HP/510 DPS, but is superseded by an unquantified July balance change.

sources.title: July Balance Update
sources.limitations: Supercell confirms a small top-level HP and damage reduction but deliberately omits the replacement values and all deterministic movement, projectile, destruction and ordering mechanics.

sources.title: Dragon Rider
sources.limitations: The dated table gives L1-L6 HP/DPS, including the otherwise unpublished L6 post-July 5,900 HP/490 DPS, and describes air movement plus defense priority. Its 3.5-tile range conflicts with the separately corroborated 4-tile historical range, and it gives no destruction damage, radius, projectile, target-tie, pathing, collision or fixed-tick timing contract.

sources.title: Dragon Rider
sources.limitations: The indexed page corroborates defense priority, cadence 1.2 seconds, range 4 tiles, death radius 2 tiles, death damage table and the May L6 values, but not the later July replacement values or a current client build.

support.note: Core materializes the immutable L1-L6 flying, defense-priority direct parent with the official ground-and-air target class through the same BattleState used by Headless, Viewer and RL.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only parent retaining May L6 6,000 HP/510 DPS although Supercell later announced an unquantified July reduction.
changed_values.replacement: The L1-L6 parent is classified as an executable shared-Core baseline, while the current secondary observation of L6 5,900 HP/490 DPS (588 per 1.2-second shot) is preserved but deliberately not applied to GameData.
changed_values.justification: The exact secondary L6 observation conflicts with independently corroborated range data from the same purported current source, while Supercell did not publish July replacement numbers. Retaining May's primary values avoids silently replacing a frozen/tested primary contract with an insufficiently corroborated value.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines equal-distance defense ties, defense reachability, target loss, flight route, projectile launch/travel/impact, attack wind-up, contact/collision, retarget timing, spell/trap ordering, death-damage target eligibility or same-tick ordering.

Goblins Farm reports a current L6 5,900 HP/490 DPS and 3.5-tile range whereas the independently indexed table and immutable payload report 4 tiles. The exact L6 observation is recorded but not imported until it is corroborated by a reproducible current source; the pre-existing May-primary 6,000/510 Core record remains partial.

Death damage and two-tile death radius are corroborated only by historical/current-version-unknown secondary material except the official L1-L3 launch values. No source establishes their post-July L6 state or a deterministic destruction impact contract.
No source supplies source-verified current L6 assets or visual timing. The Core projectile representation is a deterministic model, not a verified client trajectory.
conclusion: Dragon Rider L1-L6 is executable as a source-bounded flying, defense-priority direct parent through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL at the preserved May-primary L6 values. The post-July secondary observation is data-only pending corroboration; range, death behavior, flight/pathing, projectiles, collision, ordering and visual fidelity remain partial.
